account.backup.replaces: {counts} is a comma-separated list such as "3 workspaces, 120 cards" or the word account.backup.nothing.
account.data.nothingChanged: {problem} is a full sentence explaining why the restore failed.
account.recovery.fileTitle: First line of the downloaded recovery-codes text file; {site} is the server's host name.
admin.audit.line: An audit log line: {who} is a username or admin.audit.system, {what} one of admin.audit.action.* ("alice created the account").
admin.audit.withField: {line} is admin.audit.line, {field} a technical setting name (registration).
admin.audit.withTarget: {line} is admin.audit.line, {target} the username the action was about.
admin.backup.restore.extract: {file} is the placeholder <file> for the archive name; keep the command as it is.
admin.backup.schedule: <code> wraps a command; keep it untranslated. {file} is the placeholder <file>.
admin.email.failure.withCode: {text} is one of admin.email.failure.*, {code} a numeric SMTP reply code.
admin.email.secretState: {state} is a technical state word from the server (missing, invalid).
admin.users.notice.signedOut: {name} is a username; the plural follows the number of sessions.
admin.users.resetLink.text: {until} is a formatted date and time.
apiError.unknown: Shown for an error code this app version does not know yet; {code} is the technical code (e.g. sync_page_invalid).
app.name: The product name, shown last in every page title ("Stats · qinqin"). Keep it as is unless the product has an established name in the language.
auth.error.rateLimitedSignIn: {wait} is a format.duration.* text ("6 seconds", "15 minutes").
entry.reading.on: Japanese on'yomi reading label ("On: カン").
features.switchedOff.text: <link> wraps the link to Settings → Features; keep the arrow or use the language's own menu path notation.
flashcards.deck.numbers: {words} is flashcards.deck.words, {cards} flashcards.deck.cards; the others are numbers.
flashcards.delete.split: {head} is flashcards.delete.head; {parts} a comma-separated list of flashcards.delete.staysIn / movesToGeneral.
flashcards.sched.daysPair: "d" abbreviates days; {before} and {after} are numbers with one decimal.
flashcards.widget.streakDays: Follows the bold streak number ("5 days streak"); the number itself is outside the message.
flashcards.widget.streakDone: Follows flashcards.widget.streakDays on the same line.
goals.progress.newCards: {amount} is today's count; # is the target, which the plural follows ("32 of 50 new cards today").
milestones.card.status: Announced by screen readers: {heading} is milestones.card.*, {titles} a comma-separated list of milestone titles.
milestones.title.levelComplete: {level} is the level's name ("HSK Words · HSK 1").
milestones.title.reviews: {n} is the formatted threshold ("1,000"); the plural follows the same number. Keep in step with docs/contracts/milestones/catalogue.json titles.
milestones.titleWithDay: {title} is a milestone title, {reached} is milestones.reachedOn ("reached 3 November 2026").
nav.brand.home: Accessible name of the logo link to the home page; {app} is the product name.
packs.installed: {name} is the pack's name; {summary} the server's import summary (English, e.g. "120,000 entries") or packs.installedDone.
packs.list.buildFailed: {error} is the server's build error text (English).
packs.list.none: <code> wraps a command; keep it untranslated.
packs.package.ready: {id} is a technical package id (lexicon.zh); {mb} a formatted number with one decimal.
packs.uninstall.dictionary: `qinqin seed` is a command; keep it untranslated, with its backticks.
search.matched: Under a search result: which field matched; {source} is search.matchedWritten or a reading type such as pinyin.
search.parts.radicalName: Accessible name of a chip; {char} is the radical glyph, {n} its Kangxi number.
settings.account.delete.cannotUndo: <download> wraps a button that downloads the user's data.
settings.account.delete.typeToConfirm: Label of a text field; {name} is the user's own username, which they must type exactly.
settings.account.sessions.tokenNote: {note} is settings.tokens.revokedToo ("Your access tokens are revoked too.").
settings.ai.custom.refreshFailed: Appended to settings.ai.custom.added/saved/removed; starts with a space and a dash.
settings.ai.note: Review, Ideas and Read with AI are the journal's button labels; use the same words as those buttons.
settings.ai.usage: All four arguments are formatted numbers.
settings.home.parked: Follows a list of widget names ("Journal (qinqin-journal) stays in your layout …"); the plural follows how many.
stats.duration.underMinute: "Less than one minute"; {less} is the sign "<" (a literal "<" is not allowed in a message).
stats.map.filtered: {shown} and {total} are formatted numbers; the plural follows the shown count.
study.summary.cardsIn: Between bold numbers: "12 cards in 2 decks · 3 due · 5 new"; each fragment is one message.
weekly.day.name: Accessible name of a day in the week strip; {date} is "Monday 16 November", {state} one of weekly.day.*.
widgets.characters.stale: <code> wraps the command name; keep it untranslated.
widgets.words.inDecks: Follows the bold total ("12 words in your decks ·"); the number itself is shown before it, outside the message.
